properties.text: ISW has observed evidence to assess that Russian forces consolidated positions or seized 139.85 kilometers but lost 167.14 square kilometers of territory in Ukraine in October 2026 for a net loss of 27.29 square kilometers.
Russian forces only made gains in Sumy and Zaporizhia oblasts, while losing territory in all other sectors of the frontline, including their priority objective of Donetsk Oblast.
But Ukrainian forces have seized the initiative in the Kupyansk, Lyman, and Oleksandrivka directions and are contesting it in western Zaporizhia Oblast.

Ukrainian Joint Forces Group Spokesperson Viktor Trehubov acknowledged on October 31 that Russian forces advanced near Hraniv (north of Kharkiv City along the international border).[32] Trehubov stated that Russian forces are focused more on expanding their advances in the area from the flanks than on advancing deeper into Kozacha Lopan (just south of Hraniv).

[33] Russian milbloggers claimed on October 30 that Russian forces advanced into central Mala Shapkivka (north of Kupyansk), western Myrove (northwest of Kupyansk), and southern Kupyansk-Vuzlovyi (southeast of Kupyansk).[34] Ukrainian forces recently advanced northeast of Borova.

Russian forces shelled a Ukrainian position south of Zelenyi Hai (northeast of Borova), according to geolocated footage published on October 30, indicating that Ukrainian forces advanced in the area.[35] Ukrainian forces struck a Russian Mi-8 helicopter in occupied Luhansk Oblast as part of Ukraine’s ongoing intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian logistics and military assets.
